title: Oracle says OpenAI infrastructure deal is fully funded after final capital raise
summary: Oracle said on Friday that its infrastructure contract with OpenAI is fully funded following a final capital raise earlier this month. Shares of Oracle rose as much as 3.3% in after
llm_summary: Oracle announced that its cloud‑computing partnership with OpenAI is now fully funded, thanks to a final capital raise it completed earlier this month. The fresh financing clears any financial hurdles for the deal, ensuring the AI startup can continue scaling its models on Oracle’s infrastructure. Following the news, Oracle’s stock jumped as much as 3.
